The commands Forge runs on each deployment of this site, from the site's directory. $FORGE_ variables such as
Run the script with the site's .env loaded
Reference: briareus-windows. Other clients match this structure, differing only as noted here.

The server list is 280px, or a third of the width if smaller. The sites column stops at an 820px reading width, and the project's own sites come first with an accent border and a 'This project' badge. A click on a card or on 'Deploy
script & .env ›' opens the site in place of the list.

The site page has three tabs: Overview (Site, Repository, 'Everything Forge reports', Open site), Deploy script and Environment. A • marks a tab with unsaved changes. The header button is 'Save', or 'Save .env' on Environment, with
Ctrl+S. Environment first shows 'The .env holds production secrets' with a 'Show .env' button.

Empty states: 'No server picked — Click a server on the left to see its Forge sites.', 'No sites on this server.', 'No Forge account is available to this project. Add one, or this project to one, under ⚙ Settings → Forge
Region names (sidebar, canvas, raise, sunken) are the theme.* roles; widths and margins are layout.* in tokens/. Greys only, on purpose.
